description: B-discard guard (player report follow-up to the Deck squish fix): a board-context B on an armed shooter used to dispatch CLEAR_ALL_ASSIGNMENTS and deselect in one silent press - a fully-aimed unit wiped one button before Confirm. Now with anything staged the FIRST B only warns (toast) and arms a 4s confirm window; a second B inside the window discards for real. This drives the T4 lesson to an armed Boyz shooter with the Sluggas aimed, presses B once and asserts the aiming survives with the warning up, presses B again and asserts the discard+deselect lands, then re-arms the shooter with RB to prove recovery. B from panel focus (covered by tut_t4_dakka_deck_squish_pad) and B with nothing staged are unchanged.

steps.comment: fresh container: the first-launch nudge swallows pad menu navigation - dismiss if present
RB cycles the acting unit to the Boyz
D-pad parks the virtual cursor so A means Assign, not click
aim the Sluggas - one staged assignment, the state B used to wipe silently

steps.script:
var sc = tree.current_scene.shooting_controller
return {"one_staged": sc.weapon_assignments.size() == 1, "armed": str(sc.active_shooter_id) == "U_BOYZ_T"}

steps.comment: clear leftover toasts so the next assertion reads only the B-press result
THE GUARD: first board-context B with staged aiming must warn, not wipe

equals.toast: 1 gun aimed — B again discards the aiming and deselects

steps.comment: the aiming survives the first press and the player is told exactly what a second press will do
second B inside the 4s window - the deliberate discard

steps.script:
var sc = tree.current_scene.shooting_controller
return {"cleared": sc.weapon_assignments.is_empty(), "deselected": str(sc.active_shooter_id) == ""}
steps.comment: the second press does what the old single press did - discard and deselect

steps.script:
var n := 0
for a in PhaseManager.current_phase_instance.pending_assignments:
	n += 1
return n
steps.comment: phase-level staging cleared too, not just the controller mirror
recovery: RB re-arms a shooter - the discard leaves the phase fully usable
